name: Template: Product Roadmap
description: Track features from idea through launch and monitoring. Each swimlane is a product area; each card is a feature or initiative.

swimlanes.name: Mobile App
swimlanes.notes: iOS and Android. Targets field workers and on-the-go board access.

swimlanes.name: Core Platform
swimlanes.notes: Web app, API, and shared infrastructure features.

swimlanes.name: Integrations
swimlanes.notes: Third-party integrations: Slack, GitHub, Jira, Zapier, webhooks.

swimlanes.name: Analytics
swimlanes.notes: Board analytics, cycle time, throughput, and reporting features.

swimlanes.name: Compliance & Security
swimlanes.notes: GDPR, SOC 2, audit logging, and security hardening features.

cards.title: Offline-first card editing
cards.description: Cards edited while offline should be queued locally and synced on reconnect. Conflict resolution strategy needs design.

cards.title: Apple Watch complication — card due dates
cards.description: 5 power users requested glanceable due-date reminders on Apple Watch. Technically feasible via watchOS complication. Low priority but high delight.

cards.title: Barcode scanner for card attachment
cards.description: Field workers want to scan a barcode (asset ID, serial number) and attach it to a card. Scoped to use device camera via React Native Vision Camera.

cards.title: Push notification preferences
cards.description: Per-type push notification preferences (card assigned, mentioned, due soon). Launched with APNs and FCM support.

comments.body: Notification preferences are live. DAU increase of 8% week-over-week since launch.
comments.author: demo1

activities.to_value: Notification preferences are live. DAU increase of 8% week-over-week since launch.

cards.title: AI card description generator
cards.description: Use AI to generate a card description from a short title. Early prototype with Claude API looks promising — cost per generation is negligible.

cards.title: Card templates library
cards.description: Allow users to save a card as a template (pre-filled title, description, checklist, labels) and apply it when creating new cards.

cards.title: Multi-board card linking
cards.description: Allow a card to link to one or more cards on other boards. Backend schema and API are done; frontend link picker UI is in progress.

checklist.text: Frontend: link picker in card detail

comments.body: Backend done. Frontend picker is the remaining work — targeting completion next sprint.
comments.author: demo2

cards.description: Real-time board activity feed showing all card changes, movements, and comments in chronological order. Launched and stable.
